title: Stocks rally as investors dive back into tech; oil slips
title_zh: 随着投资者重返科技股，股市上涨；油滑
summary: By Amanda Cooper LONDON, June 9 (Reuters) - Global stocks rallied on Tuesday as investors rushed to buy the latest dip in tech stocks, while oil prices fell after Israel and Iran agreed to halt
summary_zh: 路透伦敦 6 月 9 日 - 全球股市周二上涨，因投资者争相买入最新下跌的科技股，而以色列和伊朗同意停止制裁后油价下跌

title: Why Apple's WWDC and Siri AI hype left investors sad
title_zh: 为什么苹果的 WWDC 和 Siri AI 炒作让投资者感到悲伤
summary: Apple's stock declined almost 2% on the first day of Apple CEO Tim Cook's final Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC). The reason was more perceived letdown on the artificial intelligence front, which reawakened chatter that Apple won't dominate in the AI era.
summary_zh: 在苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克最后一次全球开发者大会 (WWDC) 的第一天，苹果股价下跌了近 2%。原因是人们对人工智能领域更加失望，这再次引发了有关苹果不会在人工智能时代占据主导地位的传言。

title: Wall St futures inch higher as chips extend gains
title_zh: 随着芯片扩大涨幅，华尔街期货小幅走高
summary: By Joel Jose , Sruthi Shankar and Twesha Dikshit June 9 (Reuters) - U.S. stock index futures rose on Tuesday, as chip stocks extended gains for a second day, while easing hostilities in the Middle
summary_zh: Joel Jose、Sruthi Shankar 和 Twesha Dikshit 6 月 9 日（路透社） - 美国股指期货周二上涨，芯片股连续第二天扩大涨幅，同时缓和了中东的敌对行动

title: Apple failed to make its AI tool to comply to EU regulations, EU Commission says
title_zh: 欧盟委员会称苹果未能使其人工智能工具符合欧盟法规
summary: BRUSSELS, June 9 (Reuters) - Apple decided not to roll out its new Siri AI tool in the European Union after it had unsuccessfully requested to be exempted of interoperability obligations for the tool,
summary_zh: 布鲁塞尔，6 月 9 日（路透社）——苹果公司在请求豁免该工具的互操作性义务未果后，决定不在欧盟推出新的 Siri 人工智能工具。

title: China Preps $295 Billion Plan to Fund Nationwide AI Buildout
title_zh: 中国准备2950亿美元计划资助全国人工智能建设
summary: (Bloomberg) -- China is preparing to spend around 2 trillion yuan ($295 billion) over the next five years on building data centers across the country, fueling Beijing’s ambition to propel the domestic AI sector and surpass the US in a potentially game-changing technology.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——中国准备在未来五年内斥资约 2 万亿元人民币（合 2,950 亿美元）在全国范围内建设数据中心，从而增强北京推动国内人工智能行业发展并在一项可能改变游戏规则的技术上超越美国的雄心。

title: Musk's Starlink leads Bezos' Amazon as airlines rush to boost in-flight Wi-Fi
title_zh: 随着航空公司急于加强机上 Wi-Fi，马斯克的 Starlink 领先于贝佐斯的亚马逊
summary: Global airlines' push to attract premium customers is making fast in-flight Wi-Fi an increasingly important perk, turning a once-patchy paid service into an emerging battleground between Elon Musk's Starlink and Jeff Bezos' Amazon Leo satellite network.
summary_zh: 全球航空公司努力吸引高端客户，使得快速的机上 Wi-Fi 成为越来越重要的福利，从而将曾经不完整的付费服务变成埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Starlink 和杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 的亚马逊 Leo 卫星网络之间的新兴战场。

title: CoreWeave Founders Have Dumped $2.3 Billion in Stock Since IPO
title_zh: 自 IPO 以来，CoreWeave 创始人已抛售 23 亿美元股票
summary: (Bloomberg) -- CoreWeave Inc.’s stock price has more than doubled since the AI data center operator’s March 2025 initial public offering.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——自这家人工智能数据中心运营商 2025 年 3 月首次公开募股以来，CoreWeave Inc. 的股价已上涨一倍多。

title: Apollo Wraps Up $35 Billion Chip Deal for Anthropic
title_zh: Apollo 为 Anthropic 完成 350 亿美元芯片交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc.

title: Elon Musk Shows Detailed Design of AI Data Center Satellite
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克展示人工智能数据中心卫星的详细设计
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Elon Musk unveiled a more detailed look at an initial version of an AI data center satellite SpaceX plans to build, providing fresh insight into the ambitious project driving the company’s highly anticipated initial public offering.Most Read from BloombergHouse ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——埃隆·马斯克公布了 SpaceX 计划建造的人工智能数据中心卫星初始版本的更详细信息，为推动该公司备受期待的首次公开募股的雄心勃勃的项目提供了新的见解。
